contentPolicy: Titles, product fields and summaries were translated or paraphrased from official pages. Article bodies are Persian editorial summaries with original-source links; not representations of complete peer-reviewed papers. No fabricated publication date, author, DOI, ISO/CE validity, prices, operational metrics, certified shade matrix, representative directory or product serial dataset. Full original visible prose from 43 official pages is separately preserved with source dates and historical-claim context. Two user-supplied Ideal-branded PDFs are offered as explicitly derived optimized web editions; they are not attributed to website download URLs.

limitations: The official website supplies JPG product and research sheets, with no linked PDF catalogue, IFU or SDS found. The 30 official-image downloads remain JPG. Two separate user-uploaded PDFs are now accessible as explicitly optimized web editions; their original filenames, bytes and SHA256 values are recorded independently.
The official company video at https://idealmakoo.com/movies/film1.mp4 returned HTTP 403 during verification; it is not marked as available.
The source product pages spell the material PAMMA. This source spelling is retained explicitly; it has not been silently corrected to PMMA.
B.Star Nano Base has a title and image but no technical text in the available source page. Missing specifications are labelled not specified.

No full official shade/variant compatibility table was found. Posterior codes N6, N2, N5, N3 appear in ten product descriptions, with 19 upper-anterior and 8 lower-anterior moulds. These are not a verified matrix of every SKU.
Current validity of CE or other certificates cannot be established from historical marketing copy or an icon on product packaging. No active certification is asserted by this dataset.
The contact page contains a missing leading zero in its first telephone number; the same number is correctly printed as 02188899776 in every footer and has been normalised to that value.

Historical articles contain inconsistent digit punctuation, duplicated paragraphs and occasionally conflicting sample labels. Summaries avoid republishing suspect numerical results as validated facts.
No authored publication timestamp was exposed for the articles. Study years within a body have not been used as publication dates.
About page contains staff size and market-ranking claims with no date; these are not used as current workforce or worldwide rank statistics.
Company page /pages/27/price is retained as historical commercial-policy context, without showing old comparisons as a current price list.

The first supplied PDF is one large raster poster containing a cover and 25 numbered panels. The web edition splits those 26 panels into pages; it has no fabricated underlying text layer. Notes and the source-page images are accessible in the reader.

The recovered filename enigmalife-mould-chart-pdf-Recovered2222-Recovered.pdf does not establish Enigma ownership: its visible cover and inspected pages carry Ideal Makoo branding. It is labelled a user-supplied Ideal-branded recovered mould guide.

The supplied chart includes genuinely empty cells and missing photographs. Empty anterior/posterior matching tables remain empty. A five-row posterior diagram is transcribed only where legible, with units explicitly not stated on that source page.

B.STAR nano plan / nano glas appears as a historical document profile; its heading/body/package names are internally inconsistent with Nano Base labels. It remains an archival section and does not create an eighteenth current official product.

Original PDFs of 47,886,307 and 55,859,721 bytes remain unchanged in the supplied attachments and are not duplicated in public or the source bundle. The web PDFs preserve all readable panels/pages at 8,051,624 and 4,904,373 bytes respectively.

The recovered guide has 32 additional anterior dimension rows transcribed from visibly legible values, with missing/unclear codes and numbers left empty. These are separate archival diagram records, not current product variants.

extractionNote.fa: پوستر تک‌صفحه‌ای اصلی، متن قابل استخراج نداشت؛ متن‌های این بخش با مشاهدهٔ تصاویر بازنویسی شده‌اند. خانه‌های خالی و اختلاف نام‌های چاپ‌شده حفظ شده‌اند.
extractionNote.en: The original one-page poster has no extractable text. These notes were transcribed or summarised by inspecting its images; empty cells and conflicting labels are retained.
extractionNote.tr: Tek sayfalık asıl posterde çıkarılabilir metin yoktur. Notlar görseller incelenerek yazılmıştır; boş hücreler ve çelişen etiketler korunmuştur.
extractionNote.ar: لا يحتوي الملصق الأصلي على نص قابل للاستخراج. أُعدت الملاحظات بمراجعة الصور؛ حُفظت الخانات الفارغة وتسميات المصدر المتعارضة.
extractionNote.ru: Одностраничный оригинал не содержит извлекаемого текста. Заметки подготовлены по изображениям; пустые ячейки и противоречивые подписи сохранены.

derivativeNote.fa: نسخهٔ وبِ مشتق‌شده: جلد و ۲۵ پنل شماره‌دارِ پوستر در ۲۶ صفحه جدا شده‌اند؛ تصاویر برای وب بهینه شده‌اند و شمارهٔ پنل اصلی حفظ شده است. فایل بارگذاری‌شدهٔ اصلی تغییر نکرده است.
derivativeNote.en: Derived web edition: the cover and 25 numbered poster panels are separated into 26 pages, with optimized images and original panel numbers retained. The uploaded original is unchanged.
derivativeNote.tr: Türetilmiş web sürümü: kapak ve 25 numaralı poster paneli 26 sayfaya ayrıldı; görseller optimize edildi, özgün panel numaraları korundu. Yüklenen asıl dosya değişmedi.
derivativeNote.ar: نسخة ويب مشتقة: فُصل الغلاف و25 لوحة مرقمة إلى 26 صفحة، مع تحسين الصور والحفاظ على أرقام اللوحات الأصلية. الملف المرفوع لم يتغير.
derivativeNote.ru: Веб-версия: обложка и 25 панелей разделены на 26 страниц; изображения оптимизированы, исходные номера сохранены. Загруженный оригинал не изменён.

extractionNote.fa: نام فایل بازیابی‌شده شامل Enigmalife است، اما جلد و محتوای قابل‌مشاهده نشان ایده‌آل ماکو دارند. بعضی جدول‌ها و تصاویر در همین فایل اصلی ناقص‌اند؛ دادهٔ پنهان یا حدسی برای تکمیل آن‌ها استفاده نشده است.
extractionNote.en: The recovered filename contains Enigmalife, but the visible cover and content bear Ideal Makoo branding. Some tables and photographs are incomplete in the supplied original; hidden text or guesses were not used to fill them.
extractionNote.tr: Kurtarılmış dosya adında Enigmalife geçer; görünen kapak ve içerik Ideal Makoo markalıdır. Asıldaki eksik tablolar ve fotoğraflar gizli metin veya tahminle tamamlanmamıştır.
extractionNote.ar: يتضمن اسم الملف المستعاد Enigmalife، لكن الغلاف والمحتوى المرئي يحملان علامة إيده‌آل ماكو. بعض الجداول والصور ناقصة في الأصل؛ لم تُستكمل بنص مخفي أو تخمين.
extractionNote.ru: Имя восстановленного файла содержит Enigmalife, однако обложка и видимый материал имеют бренд Ideal Makoo. Пробелы в таблицах и фотографиях не заполнялись скрытым текстом или догадками.

derivativeNote.fa: نسخهٔ وبِ مشتق‌شده با همان ۱۴ صفحه و ترتیب اصلی؛ تصاویر بهینه شده‌اند. فایل بارگذاری‌شدهٔ اصلی تغییر نکرده است.
derivativeNote.en: A derived web edition with the same 14 pages and source order; images are optimized. The uploaded original is unchanged.
derivativeNote.tr: Özgün 14 sayfa ve sıra korunan türetilmiş web sürümü; görseller optimize edildi. Yüklenen asıl dosya değişmedi.
derivativeNote.ar: نسخة ويب مشتقة تحافظ على الصفحات الأربع عشرة وترتيبها؛ حُسنت الصور. الملف المرفوع لم يتغير.
derivativeNote.ru: Веб-версия сохраняет 14 страниц и их порядок; изображения оптимизированы. Загруженный оригинал не изменён.
